entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The plane whose last protections have faded after Avacyn's death and which Emrakul now corrupts.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: The archangel whose death left Innistrad without protection.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: Planeswalker who summoned Emrakul to Innistrad to take revenge on Sorin Markov.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: Eldrazi titan who twists all living things into Eldrazi Horrors.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: Vampire planeswalker against whom Nahiri seeks revenge.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: Planeswalker who brings the Gatewatch to Innistrad.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: Group of planeswalkers brought by Jace to help Innistrad.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: Planeswalker who brings hordes of undead immune to Emrakul's influence.

entities.name: Eldrazi Horrors
entities.description: Living things twisted by Emrakul through five increasing levels of corruption.

events.summary: With Avacyn dead, Innistrad's last protections fade.
events.quote: With the death of Avacyn , the last protections over Innistrad have faded.

events.summary: Nahiri summons Emrakul to Innistrad to take revenge on Sorin Markov.
events.quote: Nahiri has summoned Emrakul to the plane, to take revenge on Sorin Markov .

events.summary: Emrakul twists plants, animals and sentient beings into Eldrazi Horrors.
events.quote: twists all things living, be it plants, animals, or sentient beings, into Eldrazi Horrors

events.summary: Jace brings the Gatewatch and Liliana brings hordes of undead as unlikely allies to save Innistrad.
events.quote: Jace Beleren brings the Gatewatch , and Liliana Vess brings hordes of undead immune to Emrakul's influence.

relations.note: Summoned Emrakul for revenge on him.
relations.quote: to take revenge on Sorin Markov

relations.note: The two are described as unlikely allies.
relations.quote: Innistrad's fate rests in the hands of unlikely allies
